description: An uploaded CSV file or Excel workbook. A workbook comes with its sheets, the range each one uses and its named ranges: pass a sheet's id as sheetId to also read its cells as text, which shows where a table's header row is. Then add the sheet, or a range of it that starts at the header row, to a report with addReportDatasheets. Cells show what the workbook saved: nothing is recalculated.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The uploaded file to read: the `id` returned by `createDataset`, or a datasheet's `datasetId` in `listReportDatasheets`. It can be any uploaded file of your organization, including one another member uploaded.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

range.description: The cells to read from the sheet, in A1 notation without the sheet's name, such as `A1:H40`. Omit it to read from the start of the range the sheet uses. Only with `sheetId`.

sheetId.description: A sheet of an uploaded workbook whose cells to read: one of the `sheets[].id` values of an earlier call. The answer's `cells` then holds them. Omit it to list the workbook's sheets only.

name: getDataset
title: Get an uploaded file
